name: awards-carousel.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  awards-carousel.scss — <awards-carousel>: the home page's awards strip /
//  selected-work carousel — full-bleed slides that peek into adjacent ones on
//  both sides, WebGL arrow controls, and the dot/pill navigation. Slides
//  fade+rise into view on first paint (aw-c--in-view).
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

@import '../../base/variables';
@import '../../base/mixins';
@import '../../base/fonts';
@import '../../base/placeholders';

/// Dot diameter — inactive nav dots are small squares.
$awc-dot-size: to-rem($space-md);
/// Pill length — the active dot stretches to a rounded pill.
$awc-dot-pill: to-rem($space-xl);
/// Adjacent-slide bleed: how much of the neighbors peeks in on both sides.
$awc-peek: 10vw;

// ── Base container ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
.aw-c {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translate3d(0, 32px, 0);
  transition:
    opacity 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1),
    transform 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
  will-change: opacity, transform;

  &.aw-c--in-view {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
  }

  // ── Scroll track ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  &-track {
    display: flex;
    align-items: stretch; // equal height for all slides
    overflow-x: scroll;
    scroll-snap-type: x mandatory;
    scroll-behavior: smooth;
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
    scrollbar-width: none;
    &::-webkit-scrollbar {
      display: none;
    }
  }

  &-slide {
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    scroll-snap-align: center;
    display: flex;
    align-items: stretch;
    flex-direction: column;

    &--clone {
      pointer-events: none;
      user-select: none;
    }
  }

  // ── Controls ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  &-controls {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: to-rem($space-lg);
  }

  &-spacer {
    flex: 1;
  }

  // ── Dots ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  &-dots {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: to-rem($space-xs);
    // Windowed: 1 active center + 2 partial each side
    max-width: calc(#{$awc-dot-pill} + #{$awc-dot-size} * 2 + #{to-rem($space-xs)} * 4);
    overflow: hidden;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  &-dot {
    @extend %RESETBTN;

    // 8px visual dot lives in ::before; the button itself is a ≥24px pointer target (WCAG 2.5.8)
    display: block;
    position: relative;
    height: calc(#{$awc-dot-size} * 3);
    width: calc(#{$awc-dot-size} * 3);
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: transparent;
    cursor: pointer;

    &::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 50% auto auto 50%;
      translate: -50% -50%;
      height: $awc-dot-size;
      width: $awc-dot-size;
      border-radius: $awc-dot-size;
      background: var(--text-muted);
      transition:
        width 0.25s ease,
        background 0.25s ease;
    }

    &--active::before {
      width: $awc-dot-pill;
      background: var(--text-primary);
    }

    &:hover:not(&--active)::before,
    &:focus-visible:not(&--active)::before {
      background: var(--text-secondary);
    }
  }
}

// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  VARIANT: selected work
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
.aw-c--selected {
  position: relative;

  // ── Slide widths: slightly narrower than viewport so adjacent slides peek ──
  // The section has no lateral padding (home.scss zeros it),
  // so 88vw slides → ~6vw peeking in from each side.
  // Gap between slides gives visual breathing room.
  .aw-c-track {
    gap: to-rem($space-xl);

    @include layout-768() {
      gap: to-rem($space-2xl);
    }
    @include layout-1440() {
      gap: to-rem($space-3xl);
    }
  }

  .aw-c-slide {
    width: 88vw;
    flex-basis: 88vw;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    position: relative;

    @include layout-768() {
      width: 82vw;
      flex-basis: 82vw;
    }
    @include layout-1024() {
      width: 78vw;
      flex-basis: 78vw;
    }
    @include layout-1440() {
      width: 72vw;
      flex-basis: 72vw;
    }
    @include layout-2560() {
      width: 66vw;
      flex-basis: 66vw;
    }
  }

  // ── Cover image ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // Uses a CSS custom property --cover-max-h set by JS to fit the viewport.
  .aw-c-cover {
    width: 100%;
    aspect-ratio: 16 / 7;
    max-height: var(--cover-max-h, 80vh);
    overflow: hidden;
    background: var(--grey-2);
    flex-shrink: 0;

    &-img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      object-position: center;
      display: block;
    }

    &--skel {
      aspect-ratio: 16 / 7;
      max-height: var(--cover-max-h, 80vh);

      background: linear-gradient(
        90deg,
        var(--skel-bg-1) 25%,
        var(--skel-bg-2) 50%,
        var(--skel-bg-3) 75%
      );
      background-size: 200% 100%;
      animation: skeleton-shimmer 2.4s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
  }

  // ── Label: hidden on adjacent, fades in only on active slide ─────────────
  // No %MAXAREA — the label sits inside the slide, so text aligns with the
  // slide's left edge. The archive title is aligned separately.
  .aw-c-label {
    padding: to-rem($space-sm) 0 to-rem($space-xl);
    opacity: 0;
    visibility: hidden;
    transition:
      opacity 0.4s ease,
      visibility 0.4s;
    pointer-events: none;

    &-title {
      @extend .ttl-md;

      font-weight: 200;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      padding-bottom: to-rem($space-lg);
    }

    &-desc {
      @extend .txt-md;

      font-weight: 300;
    }

    // "Click to open" — centered, corner-border animation on hover
    &-action {
      @extend %RESETBTN;
      @extend .ttl-xs;

      position: relative;
      display: block;
      text-align: center;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      padding: to-rem($space-xs) to-rem($space-lg);
      color: var(--text-muted-on-dark);
      font-weight: 700;
      white-space: nowrap;
      transition: color 0.2s ease;
      margin: to-rem($space-xl) auto 0;
      width: fit-content;
      opacity: 0;
      visibility: hidden;
      pointer-events: none;

      &::before,
      &::after {
        content: '';
        position: absolute;
        width: to-rem($space-md);
        height: to-rem($space-md);
        transition:
          width 0.25s ease,
          height 0.25s ease;
      }

      &::before {
        top: 0;
        left: 0;
        border-top: 1px solid var(--grey);
        border-left: 1px solid var(--grey);
      }

      &::after {
        bottom: 0;
        right: 0;
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--grey);
        border-right: 1px solid var(--grey);
      }

      &:hover,
      &:focus {
        color: var(--black);
      }

      &:hover::before,
      &:focus::before,
      &:hover::after,
      &:focus::after {
        width: calc(100% - #{to-rem($space-xs)});
        height: calc(100% - #{to-rem($space-xs)});
      }
    }
  }

  .aw-c-slide--active .aw-c-label {
    opacity: 1;
    visibility: visible;
    pointer-events: auto;
  }

  // Action button appears after the description animation finishes
  .aw-c-slide--active .aw-c-label-action {
    animation: action-appear 0.4s ease-out forwards;
    animation-delay: var(--action-delay, 0ms);
  }

  // home-item-link fills the full slide
  .home-item-link {
    width: 100%;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
  }
}

// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  VARIANT: explore more (archive cards)
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// Layout: carousel width is controlled by home.scss (61% on desktop, 100% mobile).
// Inside that, the active card fills ~60% of the carousel width.
// Adjacent cards peek from both sides.
// Labels hidden on inactive, fade in on active.

// Explore variant — alternate sizing/density.
.aw-c--explore {
  position: relative;

  // ── Controls: vertically centered on the image area ──────────────────────

  // ── Track ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  .aw-c-track {
    gap: to-rem($space-lg);
    padding: 0;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    width: 100%;

    @include layout-768() {
      gap: to-rem($space-xl);
    }
    @include layout-1440() {
      gap: to-rem($space-2xl);
    }
  }

  // ── Slide widths: ~60% of the carousel container ──────────────────────────
  .aw-c-slide {
    width: 85%;
    flex-basis: 85%;
    max-width: 85%;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    // Padding so the card shadow isn't clipped by the track overflow
    padding: to-rem($space-sm);

    @include layout-540() {
      width: 70%;
      flex-basis: 70%;
      max-width: 70%;
    }
    @include layout-768() {
      width: 62%;
      flex-basis: 62%;
      max-width: 62%;
    }
    @include layout-1024() {
      width: 60%;
      flex-basis: 60%;
      max-width: 60%;
    }
    @include layout-1440() {
      width: 60%;
      flex-basis: 60%;
      max-width: 60%;
    }
    @include layout-2560() {
      width: 58%;
      flex-basis: 58%;
      max-width: 58%;
    }
  }

  // ── Card styling ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  .aw-c-card {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    text-decoration: none;
    color: inherit;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    border-radius: to-rem($space-lg);
    overflow: hidden;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);

    &-cover {
      width: 100%;
      overflow: visible; // allow reflection to show below
      background: var(--grey-2);
      flex-shrink: 0;

      &-img {
        width: 100%;
        height: auto;
        display: block;
        transition: opacity 0.3s ease;

        .aw-c-card:hover &,
        .aw-c-card:focus & {
          opacity: 0.9;
        }
      }

      // Reflected image below the main cover
      &-reflection {
        width: 100%;
        height: auto;
        max-height: to-rem($space-3xl);
        display: block;
        transform: scaleY(-1);
        object-fit: cover;
        object-position: bottom;
        pointer-events: none;
        -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(0, 0, 0, 1), transparent);
        mask-image: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(0, 0, 0, 1), transparent);
      }

      &--skel {
        padding-top: 56.25%;
        background: linear-gradient(
          90deg,
          var(--skel-bg-1) 25%,
          var(--skel-bg-2) 50%,
          var(--skel-bg-3) 75%
        );
        background-size: 200% 100%;
        animation: skeleton-shimmer 2.4s ease-in-out infinite;
      }
    }

    // ── Label: hidden on non-active slides, fades in on active ──────────────
    &-label {
      padding: to-rem($space-md) to-rem($space-lg) to-rem($space-sm);
      opacity: 0;
      visibility: hidden;
      transition:
        opacity 0.4s ease,
        visibility 0.4s;
      pointer-events: none;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      text-align: center;

      &-title {
        @extend .ttl-md;

        font-weight: 200;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        padding-top: to-rem($space-md);
        padding-bottom: to-rem($space-lg);
      }

      &-desc {
        @extend .txt-sm;

        font-weight: 100;
        opacity: 0.7;
      }
    }

    // "Click to open" — centered, corner-border animation.
    // Sits outside label div, always at the bottom of the card.
    &-action {
      @extend %RESETBTN;
      @extend .ttl-xs;

      position: relative;
      display: block;
      text-align: center;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      padding: to-rem($space-xs) to-rem($space-lg);
      color: var(--text-muted-on-dark);
      font-weight: 700;
      white-space: nowrap;
      transition: color 0.2s ease;
      margin: 0 auto to-rem($space-md);
      margin-top: auto; // pushes to bottom of card
      width: fit-content;
      opacity: 0;
      visibility: hidden;
      pointer-events: none;

      &::before,
      &::after {
        content: '';
        position: absolute;
        width: to-rem($space-md);
        height: to-rem($space-md);
        transition:
          width 0.25s ease,
          height 0.25s ease;
      }

      &::before {
        top: 0;
        left: 0;
        border-top: 1px solid var(--grey);
        border-left: 1px solid var(--grey);
      }

      &::after {
        bottom: 0;
        right: 0;
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--grey);
        border-right: 1px solid var(--grey);
      }

      &:hover,
      &:focus {
        color: var(--black);
      }

      &:hover::before,
      &:focus::before,
      &:hover::after,
      &:focus::after {
        width: calc(100% - #{to-rem($space-xs)});
        height: calc(100% - #{to-rem($space-xs)});
      }
    }
  }

  // Active slide: label + action fade in
  .aw-c-slide--active .aw-c-card-label {
    opacity: 1;
    visibility: visible;
    pointer-events: auto;
  }

  // Action button appears after the description animation finishes
  .aw-c-slide--active .aw-c-card-action {
    animation: action-appear 0.4s ease-out forwards;
    animation-delay: var(--action-delay, 0ms);
  }
}

// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  VARIANT: awards (dark footer, 10s timer)
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
.aw-c--awards {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 100%;

  // Controls: horizontal dot row centered under the slide. The old
  // absolute vertical column was capped at the image height — once dots
  // became ≥24px pointer targets (WCAG 2.5.8) the column overflowed and
  // painted over the award text. `order` re-seats the row (rendered
  // before the track in DOM) below the slides.
  .aw-c-controls {
    position: static;
    order: 2;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    height: auto;
    padding: 0;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    margin-top: to-rem($space-sm);
  }

  // Dots — active is same size but white (scoped to awards only)
  .aw-c-dot {
    &::before {
      background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-white-raw) 30%, transparent);
    }

    &--active::before {
      width: $awc-dot-size;
      background: var(--color-white-raw);
    }

    &:hover:not(&--active)::before,
    &:focus-visible:not(&--active)::before {
      background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-white-raw) 55%, transparent);
    }
  }

  // Dot row — shows every dot, wraps on very narrow viewports
  .aw-c-dots {
    flex-direction: row;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    max-width: 100%;
    overflow: visible;
  }

  .aw-c-track {
    order: 1;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: to-rem($space-8xl);
    min-width: 0;
  }

  .aw-c-slide {
    width: 100%;
    flex-basis: 100%;
    justify-content: center;
  }

  .aw-c-award {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    text-align: center;
    text-decoration: none;
    color: $color-white;
    gap: to-rem($space-xs);
    padding: to-rem($space-lg) to-rem($space-sm);
    width: 100%;

    &-media {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: to-rem($space-3xl);
      width: to-rem($space-5xl);
      height: to-rem($space-5xl);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    &-img {
      max-width: to-rem($space-5xl);
      max-height: to-rem($space-5xl);
      width: auto;
      height: auto;
      object-fit: contain;
      // No filter — images display naturally
    }

    &-text {
      @extend .txt-xs;

      font-weight: 100;
      opacity: 0.7;
      max-width: to-rem($space-7xl);
    }
  }
}

// ── Action button delayed appearance ─────────────────────────────────────────
@keyframes action-appear {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    visibility: hidden;
    pointer-events: none;
    transform: translateY(6px);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    visibility: visible;
    pointer-events: auto;
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
}

// Keyboard focus ring on this shadow root's tabbable elements — the file
// doesn't import _structure (which emits it globally), so include the
// shared scope explicitly.
@include focus-ring-scope;
